name: ks-flow
description: Per-project Kanban board over your Claude Code sessions, with macOS notifications when a session blocks waiting for you

project_path.title: Project path
project_path.description: Main worktree / repo root to track. All of its git worktrees are tracked too; every other project on the machine is ignored.

workflow_user.title: Workflow username
workflow_user.description: The workflow/<username>/ segment to watch for state.yaml files. Defaults to the username found in a state.yaml, else derived from git config.

db_provider.title: DB provider
db_provider.description: Backing store. Leave blank to auto-select: 'pocketbase' (zero-config local default — a bundled server, no GCP) unless a cloud Firestore project is configured, in which case 'firestore'. Set explicitly to 'pocketbase' or 'firestore' to force.

pocketbase_port.title: PocketBase port
pocketbase_port.description: Localhost port for the bundled PocketBase server (db_provider=pocketbase). The daemon starts it; the board reads from it.

firestore_mode.title: Firestore mode
firestore_mode.description: 'emulator' (local-only, no GCP) or 'cloud' (durable archive in a real Firestore project). Only used when db_provider=firestore.

gcp_project_id.title: GCP project id
gcp_project_id.description: Firestore/Firebase project id (service-account 'project_id'). Required when firestore_mode=cloud.

firestore_client_email.title: Service-account client email
firestore_client_email.description: Admin SDK service-account 'client_email' (daemon writer). Required when firestore_mode=cloud.

firestore_private_key.title: Service-account private key
firestore_private_key.description: Admin SDK service-account 'private_key' (PEM). Paste with literal \n escapes on one line. Required when firestore_mode=cloud.

firestore_credentials.title: Firestore service-account key (optional)
firestore_credentials.description: Optional fallback: path to the full service-account JSON, used only if the client-email/private-key fields are unset.

firebase_api_key.title: Firebase web API key
firebase_api_key.description: Client-SDK apiKey for the board reader (public; from Project settings → web app). Required when firestore_mode=cloud. authDomain/storageBucket derive from gcp_project_id.

firebase_app_id.title: Firebase web app id
firebase_app_id.description: Client-SDK appId for the board reader (optional; from the same web app config).

idle_minutes.title: Idle threshold (minutes)
idle_minutes.description: A session with no timestamped activity for this many minutes is marked idle.

notify_throttle_sec.title: Notify throttle (seconds)
notify_throttle_sec.description: Suppress repeat notifications for the same session within this window.

board_port.title: Board port
board_port.description: Port the Next.js board listens on (ks-flow open).
